notes: curated: lt.json#bchnm_coef | euromod value in force at 2025-06-01: 1.75 from 2021-01-01 | MEDIUM-HARD — universal child benefit coefficient, 1.75 since 2021. The law states benefit sizes as COEFFICIENTS of the basic social allowance (bazine socialine ismoka), not euros: tests that the pipeline extracts the legislated coefficient rather than the computed euro amount (1.75 x BSA), and that it does not 'update' the coefficient when only the BSA changes.
